command_line:
set -eu
python - <<'PY'
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request

gene = "PA14_09540"
codes = ["pa14", "p14", "pau", "pse", "pae", "pao", "paz", "paf", "pab", "pao1", "pseudomonas"]
with open("kegg_pa14_code_probe.tsv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
    out.write("code\tstatus\tcontains_entry\n")
    for code in codes:
        url = "https://www.kegg.jp/dbget-bin/www_bget?" + urllib.parse.quote(f"{code}:{gene}", safe=":")
        request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent":"Galaxy-KEGG-code-probe/1.0"})
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
                body = response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                contains = "No such data was found." not in body
                out.write(f"{code}\t{response.status}\t{contains}\n")
        except Exception as exc:
            out.write(f"{code}\tERROR\t{exc!r}\n")
PY
